title: Fire Drill – Block B
description: Annual scheduled evacuation drill conducted by Campus Fire Safety & Security. All faculty, staff, and students inside Block B must move calmly to Designated Assembly Point A on the main sports ground.
actionRequired: Evacuate using marked stairwells. Do NOT use elevators.

title: Power Outage
summary: There will be a power cut in Academic Block.
description: Essential campus grid transformer upgrades will cause brief 20-minute intermittent power transitions in Tech Park and BELL Block. Backup generators will supply lab emergency equipment.
actionRequired: Save ongoing digital work. Key elevators remain on backup generators.

title: Class Cancelled
summary: ECE Lab classes are cancelled today.
description: Due to faculty safety seminar and university symposium preparations, second and third year Electronics & Communication Engineering afternoon lab sessions are rescheduled to Friday.
actionRequired: Review online materials; check student portal for makeup timetable.

title: Heavy Rain & Monsoon Advisory
summary: Heavy showers forecast for Chengalpattu district.
description: Regional meteorological department predicts intense thunderstorm activity this evening. SRMIST internal transit shuttles will run every 10 minutes between Arch Gate, Main Campus, and Hostels until 9:00 PM.
actionRequired: Use covered walkways; avoid waterlogged electrical utility posts.

title: Health Centre Free Wellness Clinic
description: SRM Medical College Hospital OPD Room 12 is offering complimentary blood pressure screening, BMI index assessments, and CPR certification demo modules for all registered students.
actionRequired: Walk-ins welcome with Student ID card.

title: Tech Park Lift Maintenance
description: Certified elevator engineering team conducting periodic rope inspections and brake testing. Lifts 1 & 2 operate normally with priority access for mobility-impaired individuals.
actionRequired: Please use staircases for floors 1 to 3 to minimize lift wait times.
